# What the Silk Road needs at game start on a generated map.
#
# Vanilla seeds each stop's first innovation only on its own three start dates, and
# draws every later one from what the culture at Chang'an knows. Here the source
# bazaar's culture is given the innovations the road carries, by era, and each stop
# is seeded with vanilla's preset for the nearest vanilla start — otherwise nothing
# moves for twelve years and the visit-a-market decision stays hidden.

on_game_start_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = { gen_silk_road_setup }
}

gen_silk_road_setup = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_tgp_dlc_trigger = yes
				exists = situation:silk_road_situation
			}
			# The source bazaar's people may learn everything the road carries, and know what their era allows.
			title:c_jingzhao.culture = {
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_champa_rice }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_sericulture }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_dragon_kiln }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_block_printing }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_cupellation }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_lacquered_armor }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_coking }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_composite_crossbow }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_pharmacopoeia }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_waterworks }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_fire_medicine }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_compass }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_grenades }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_double_entry_bookkeeping }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = silk_road_unlocked_innovations target = culture_innovation:innovation_bulkheads }
				add_innovation = innovation_champa_rice
				add_innovation = innovation_sericulture
				add_innovation = innovation_dragon_kiln
				add_innovation = innovation_block_printing
				add_innovation = innovation_cupellation
				add_innovation = innovation_lacquered_armor
				add_innovation = innovation_coking
				add_innovation = innovation_composite_crossbow
				add_innovation = innovation_pharmacopoeia
				add_innovation = innovation_waterworks
				add_innovation = innovation_fire_medicine
				add_innovation = innovation_compass
				add_innovation = innovation_grenades
				add_innovation = innovation_double_entry_bookkeeping
				add_innovation = innovation_bulkheads
			}
			# Each stop's first innovation, unless the situation already set one.
			situation:silk_road_situation = {
				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_china = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { exists = var:innovation }
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = innovation
							value = culture_innovation:innovation_dragon_kiln
						}
					}
				}
				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_tibet = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { exists = var:innovation }
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = innovation
							value = culture_innovation:innovation_block_printing
						}
					}
				}
				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_india = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { exists = var:innovation }
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = innovation
							value = culture_innovation:innovation_waterworks
						}
					}
				}
				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_central_asia = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { exists = var:innovation }
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = innovation
							value = culture_innovation:innovation_block_printing
						}
					}
				}
				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_transcaspia = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { exists = var:innovation }
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = innovation

				situation_sub_region:region_silk_road_proper_occident = {
